desc.zh-CN: OpenAI官方最新推出的备受外界期待的、性能更强的新一代人工智能模型GPT-5系列，版本号为gpt-5.4。
desc.en-US: The latest, highly anticipated and powerful next-generation LLM named GPT-5 that officially launched by OpenAI, version gpt-5.4.

desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 是 DeepSeek 推出的高性能旗舰大模型，在推理、编程、长文本处理与综合任务能力上进一步增强。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is DeepSeek’s flagship high-performance model, further enhancing reasoning, coding, long-text processing, and overall task capability.

desc.zh-CN: Claude Opus 4.7 是 Anthropic 推出的高端旗舰模型，重点提升了深度推理、复杂写作、代码生成与高可靠性任务处理能力。
desc.en-US: Claude Opus 4.7 is Anthropic’s flagship high-end model, with a focus on stronger deep reasoning, complex writing, code generation, and reliable task handling.

desc.zh-CN: Doubao-Seed-2-0-Pro-260215 是字节跳动最新推出的高性能通用闭源模型。
desc.en-US: Doubao-Seed-2-0-Pro-260215 is ByteDance’s latest high-performance proprietary general-purpose model.

desc.zh-CN: Moonshot 最新发布的的1T参数大模型，提升了长程编码能力与Agent自主化执行能力，具备代码、长程任务执行和Agent集群能力。
desc.en-US: Kimi-K2.6 is Moonshot’s latest 1T-parameter large model, featuring improved long-horizon coding and autonomous agent execution capabilities, with strengths in coding, long-horizon task execution, and agent collaboration.

desc.zh-CN: Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 是 Google 推出的 Gemini 3.1 Pro 预览版本，面向高难度推理、多模态理解与复杂生产级任务。
desc.en-US: Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview is Google’s preview release of Gemini 3.1 Pro, designed for challenging reasoning, multimodal understanding, and complex production-grade tasks.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview 是 Qwen 推出的闭源旗舰模型，聚焦更强推理能力、复杂任务处理与高质量对话表现。
desc.en-US: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview is Qwen’s flagship proprietary model, focusing on stronger reasoning, complex task handling, and high-quality conversational performance.

desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 是 DeepSeek 推出的高效率轻量化模型，面向低延迟交互、高并发调用与日常智能应用场景。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-V4-Flash is DeepSeek’s efficiency-oriented lightweight model for low-latency interaction, high-concurrency usage, and everyday intelligent applications.

desc.zh-CN: Doubao-Seed-2-0-Lite-260215 是字节跳动最新推出的轻量化通用闭源模型。
desc.en-US: Doubao-Seed-2-0-Lite-260215 is ByteDance’s latest lightweight proprietary general-purpose model.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-5.1 是智谱推出的新一代通用大模型，该模型能够在长达8小时的任务中独立工作，完成复杂的工程项目，在代码能力和长程任务执行上相比前代模型有所提升。
desc.en-US: GLM-5.1 is Zhipu AI’s next-generation general-purpose large model. It can work autonomously on tasks lasting up to eight hours and complete complex engineering projects, with improved coding ability and long-horizon task execution compared with its predecessor.

desc.zh-CN: Claude Sonnet 4.6 是 Anthropic 推出的均衡型主力模型，在性能、速度与成本之间提供面向通用业务场景的高性价比选择。
desc.en-US: Claude Sonnet 4.6 is Anthropic’s balanced mainstream model, offering a cost-effective trade-off among capability, speed, and cost for general business use cases.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3.5 是阿里近期推出的重要基础模型，在多模态融合、混合高效架构、规模化强化学习、多语言覆盖及训练基建上实现全面升级，性能与实用性大幅提升。
desc.en-US: Qwen3.5 is a significant foundation model recently launched by Alibaba, featuring comprehensive upgrades in multimodal fusion, efficient hybrid architecture, scalable reinforcement learning, multilingual coverage and training infrastructure, with greatly improved performance and practicality.

desc.zh-CN: Hy3 preview是腾讯混元团队重组后发布并开源的新模型，在复杂推理、指令遵循、上下文学习、代码、智能体等能力及推理性能上有所提升。
desc.en-US: Hy3-preview is a newly released and open-sourced model launched after the reorganization of Tencent Hunyuan’s team, with improvements in complex reasoning, instruction following, in-context learning, coding, agent capabilities, and inference efficiency.

desc.zh-CN: Ring-2.5-1T 是 Ring-1T 的升级版，由 inclusionAI打造，是全球首个基于混合线性注意力架构的万亿参数思考模型。
desc.en-US: Ring-2.5-1T is an upgraded version of Ring-1T, developed by inclusionAI, and is the world’s first trillion-parameter reasoning model based on a hybrid linear attention architecture.

desc.zh-CN: OpenAI官方最新推出的备受外界期待的、性能更强的新一代人工智能模型GPT-5系列，版本号为gpt-5.4。
desc.en-US: The latest, highly anticipated and powerful next-generation LLM named GPT-5 that officially launched by OpenAI, version gpt-5.4.

desc.zh-CN: MiniMax 推出的新一代通用大模型，通过构建Agent Harness体系，深度参与自身训练与优化流程，在部分研发场景中可承担30%—50%的工作量，并在内部评测集上实现约30%的效果提升。
desc.en-US: MiniMax-M2.7 is MiniMax’s new-generation general-purpose large model. By building an Agent Harness system, it deeply participates in its own training and optimization process, can take on 30%–50% of the workload in some R&D scenarios, and achieves about a 30% improvement on internal evaluation benchmarks.

desc.zh-CN: Grok-4.20-0309 是 xAI 推出的新一代推理模型，强调实时信息能力、复杂问题分析以及更强的工具化任务表现。
desc.en-US: Grok-4.20-0309 is xAI’s next-generation reasoning model, emphasizing real-time information capability, complex problem analysis, and stronger tool-oriented task performance.

desc.zh-CN: Step 3.5 Flash是阶跃星辰于最新发布的开源模型，在Agent场景和数学任务上表现良好，能够处理复杂、长链条任务。
desc.en-US: Step 3.5 Flash is StepFun’s newly released open-source model, performing well in agent scenarios and mathematical tasks, and capable of handling complex, long-chain tasks.

desc.zh-CN: gemma-4-31B-it 是 Google 推出的 31B 参数开源模型，面向高质量对话、推理与开发者自部署场景。
desc.en-US: gemma-4-31B-it is Google’s 31B-parameter open-source model for high-quality conversation, reasoning, and self-deployment by developers.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3.6 是 Qwen 系列的新一代开源模型，3.5系列的升级版。
desc.en-US: Qwen3.6 is the next-generation open-source model in the Qwen family and an upgraded version of the Qwen3.5 series.

desc.zh-CN: Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite-Preview 是 Google 推出的轻量级预览模型，强调低成本、低时延以及高吞吐场景下的实用能力。
desc.en-US: Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite-Preview is Google’s lightweight preview model focused on practical capability under low cost, low latency, and high-throughput settings.

desc.zh-CN: 中国移动最新推出的闭源模型。
desc.en-US: China Mobile’s latest closed-source model.

desc.zh-CN: gemma-4-E4B-it 是 Google 推出的轻量级端侧开源模型。
desc.en-US: gemma-4-E4B-it is a lightweight open-source on-device model released by Google.
